description: This file contains JUnit 5 test cases for the YearStatistics class in a book tracking application. It tests methods for retrieving the lowest and highest rated books of the year, number of books this year, and average rating calculations, ensuring correct functionality and handling of edge cases.

classes.name: YearStatisticsTest
classes.description: Test class for YearStatistics, verifies functionality related to yearly book ratings and counts.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data by resetting the database, populating books, and creating YearStatistics instance.

methods.name: findLowestRatedBookThisYear
methods.description: Asserts that the method correctly finds the book with the lowest rating this year.

methods.name: notFindNonExistentLowestRatedBook
methods.description: Tests that the method returns empty when no lowest-rated book exists.

methods.name: highestRatedBookExistsAndIsFound
methods.description: Checks that the most liked book of the year is correctly identified.

methods.name: testNonExistentHighestRatedBook
methods.description: Ensures the method handles absence of highest-rated books properly.

methods.name: TestNumberOfBooksThisYear
methods.description: Verifies the count of books read this year.

methods.name: averageRatingExistsAndIsCorrect
methods.description: Validates the accuracy of the average rating calculation.

methods.name: haveNoAverageRatingStatisticsWhenThereAreNoStatistics
methods.description: Checks that average rating calculation returns empty when no data is available.

methods.name: resetRatingStatistics
methods.description: Helper method to clear data and reset statistic object.
